arithmetic.measure: share of nodes in the largest strongly connected component (F-022)
arithmetic.chain: no cycle, so every component is a single node: measure = 1/4 = 0.25
arithmetic.cycle: one cycle covers all four parts: measure = 4/4 = 1.0
arithmetic.partial: a three-part cycle plus one dependent part: measure = 3/4 = 0.75

conditions.graph: hand-built from the part-support relation, not read from organ.rs

fires.evidence: the measure separates a chain from a cycle

specific.evidence: a closed cycle gives 1.0, a partial cycle gives 3/n

verdict.reason: the closure measure behaves as the graph definition predicts: 0.25 for a chain, 0.75 for a partial cycle, 1.0 for a closed cycle

limitations: The graphs are hand-built illustrations of the measure, not a reading of the model: the real part-support relation in organ.rs is not extracted here. Weights are absent, so the measure is structural only.
